parameters.name: action_type
parameters.description: One of: kill_pending, cancel_running, pause_class, unpause_class, retry_failed, delete_failed, retry_modified, reset_metrics, drain_restart.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Filter audit rows that targeted a specific tenant.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Filter by the user who triggered the action.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only rows created at/after this timestamp.
